blocks.text: Edge devices, data platform and AI, in one product

Castlematic is where Purview’s edge and IoT engineering meets its data and AI practice: devices in vehicles, a cloud platform ingesting telemetry at scale, and analytics that turn it into decisions. The diagnostics heritage from Detroit adds what most trackers lack, a view inside the engine as well as on the map.
Tracking, diagnostics and the decisions between them

items.title: Live tracking
items.body: Real-time location, routes, stops and status for every vehicle, on web and mobile.

items.title: Vehicle health and diagnostics
items.body: Engine data, fault codes and service indicators read from the vehicle, with maintenance scheduling.

items.title: Driver behaviour
items.body: Harsh braking, speeding, idling and scoring, for safety and fuel.

items.title: Geofencing and alerts
items.body: Zones, schedules and rules that trigger alerts to managers and drivers.

items.title: Trip, fuel and utilisation reports
items.body: Daily and periodic reporting, exports and dashboards for operations and finance.

items.title: APIs and integrations
items.body: Telemetry into your ERP, dispatch, insurance or dealer systems.

items.title: Fit the device
items.body: Plug-in or installed telematics units, matched to vehicle type and data needs.

items.title: Pair and configure
items.body: Vehicles, drivers, zones and alert rules set up in the platform.

items.title: Track
items.body: Positions and diagnostics stream to the platform and appear live on the map.

items.title: Alert
items.body: Rules fire on events: a zone breach, a fault code, a service due.

items.title: Report and improve
items.body: Reports and scores show where fuel, safety and uptime can improve.

blocks.text: What Purview runs behind the platform

items.title: Edge to cloud, operated as a service
items.body: Purview supplies and supports the devices, runs the ingestion platform and analytics, and integrates telemetry into client systems, with the diagnostics engineering from the Detroit business informing vehicle-health models.
